name: EPIC 249583614
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 13.3 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,997 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.80 solar masses and 13.3 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,734 K at its surface.
